instruction: A candid outdoor full-body photograph shows a couple sharing a kiss while walking. On the left, the blonde woman in the checkered dress (R2) holds a bouquet of red roses and leans in to kiss her partner. On the right, the man in the peach t-shirt (R1) leans in to kiss her back. They are holding hands while walking side-by-side on a paved path. The scene is bathed in bright, direct midday sunlight that casts distinct shadows on the ground, with lush green foliage filling the background.
